fields.description: Issue includes Wen IL PHILLIPS' "NOTEBOOK" column with commentary on the 1934 World Series incident involving 3rd-baseman Owen and Judge Landis, and extensive local political coverage focused on Miami Beach (including discussion of Val Cleary, Abraham Frank Katzentine, and Cox-News influence, with references to state and federal involvement). Also features horse-racing coverage and tips ("HORSE SENSE" / "JOCKEY JIMMY"), radio program schedules for WQAM/WIOD, local society/column items ("Round the Town"), and numerous advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach businesses and nightlife venues.
